e.title: Run-Off Tracker
e.summary: 停售保单组合（run-off book）收缩监控仪表盘：组合经理与精算师监测财务收缩
e.body: Run-Off Tracker 是 Xitus Legacy 的仪表盘：让组合经理与精算师监测停售保险组合（run-off books）随时间的财务收缩——准备金释放、理赔终结、组合径流的可视化监控。对 RIAA：run-off 管理的工程范式（停售组合的监控是再保/收购场景的实际需求）。与 [[chainladder]]（准备金）、[[longitudinal-reserving]]（CAS 纵向）、[[insurance-governance]] 互补。关联 [[actuarial-pricing]]、[[reinsurance]]。
e.verified_note: raw README 核实：停售保险组合收缩监控仪表盘（准备金释放/组合径流，组合经理+精算师）
e.summary_en: Dashboard for monitoring the financial contraction of discontinued insurance books (run-off portfolios): for portfolio managers and actuaries
e.summary_hk: 停售保單組合（run-off book）收縮監控儀表盤：組合經理與精算師監測財務收縮
e.body_en: Run-Off Tracker is Xitus Legacy's dashboard for portfolio managers and actuaries to monitor the financial contraction of discontinued insurance books (run-off portfolios) over time — reserve release, claim run-off and portfolio decay in one view. For RIAA: the engineering pattern for run-off management (monitoring discontinued books is a real need in reinsurance/acquisition scenarios). Complements [[chainladder]] (reserving), [[longitudinal-reserving]] (CAS longitudinal) and [[insurance-governance]]. Related: [[actuarial-pricing]], [[reinsurance]].
e.body_hk: Run-Off Tracker 是 Xitus Legacy 的儀表盤：讓組合經理與精算師監測停售保險組合（run-off books）隨時間的財務收縮——準備金釋放、理賠終結、組合徑流的可視化監控。對 RIAA：run-off 管理的工程範式（停售組合的監控是再保/收購場景的實際需求）。與 [[chainladder]]（準備金）、[[longitudinal-reserving]]（CAS 縱向）、[[insurance-governance]] 互補。關聯 [[actuarial-pricing]]、[[reinsurance]]。
